assessment.basis: Conditional independent refit; matching within printed errors is similarity, not reproduction of the original statistical procedure. V0 preliminary g-G fit not repeated.
qualifications: Conditional independent refit; matching within printed errors is similarity, not reproduction of the original statistical procedure. V0 preliminary g-G fit not repeated. Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The 32 P7 hot observations give about 7.1 GPa pressure RMS with the published coefficients, versus about 1.1 GPa reported in Table 7; passing Table 8 checkpoints does not resolve that discrepancy.
